verdict_and_recommendations.justification: All material discrepancies between the Markdown report and JSON artifact have been forensically tracked to their root causes and reconciled against the underlying immutable ledgers and models. Zero accounting invariants failed. All 67 automated regression and reconciliation tests pass.
safe_findings_to_retain: The low-conviction dilution thesis: trades with P(BUY) in [0.33, 0.40) generated 100% of the portfolio's net loss (-INR 227,302.00 across 350 trades).
High-conviction profitability: trades with P(BUY) >= 0.40 generated positive net alpha (+INR 66,623.36 across 271 trades).

The adverse selection time-stop trap: EARLY_SELL_SIGNAL exits were net profitable (+INR 160,893.61 across 337 trades), while MAX_HOLD_5D exits caused severe losses (-INR 307,827.78 across 276 trades).
Statutory delivery friction drag: INR 213,207.51 consumed 405.89% of gross alpha.
Capacity ceiling blocking: 1,383 candidate signals were rejected while 10 slots were locked.
